name: Dawnglade Regent — no hexproof while its controller is not the monarch
notes: Before the monarch condition branch, Dawnglade Regent's 'As long as you're the monarch, permanents you control have hexproof' had its condition dropped and always applied. Player 1 is the monarch and their tab is open; Player 2 controls Dawnglade Regent and Grizzly Bears, which do not have hexproof (reading the open tab would give it). The positive case is dawnglade-regent-monarch-condition. Memory: project_monarch_initiative_conditions_2026-10-14.
